sentences.text: The evidence does not show a replacement for the Key Facts Statement after its withdrawal in 2025.
For a UCB, the later in-force directions still require a Key Facts Statement to be provided in a standardised format to prospective borrowers before the loan contract is executed.
For the same UCB term-loan context, that Key Facts Statement must also include a computation sheet of Annual Percentage Rate and the amortisation schedule of the loan over the loan tenor.
So, on the evidence provided, nothing “replaces” the Key Facts Statement; the operative document remains the Key Facts Statement under the UCB directions.

missing.searched: RBI withdrawal notice and the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025; no separate replacement document was found in the provided evidence.
